{{DISPLAYTITLE:shea_cosplays}}
'''shea_cosplays''' is a cosplayer shown in the image used on one [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The card prints the credit as "Image featuring dynamic-dryad & shea_cosplays courtesy of www.heroicimaging.com". The same credit line also names dynamic-dryad and www.heroicimaging.com. The credited card is [[I've Been Searching For You For Some Time (ALT)|I've Been Searching For You For Some Time (AI)]], in [[Virtual Set 13]] (released 2020).
